method: AI-led bounded web searches and direct opens of official vendor documentation. Facts are documentation findings, not authenticated API execution or human verification.

apps.name: GitHub
apps.unresolved: GraphQL breadth not separately audited in this pass; scope prototype to evidenced REST operations.

apps.name: Vercel
apps.unresolved: Own REST wrapper is straightforward; official MCP client eligibility can constrain custom clients.

apps.name: Netlify
apps.unresolved: No general access blocker; respect hosting credit and plan limits.

apps.name: Cloudflare
apps.unresolved: No general blocker; token roles and paid product entitlements constrain some actions.

apps.name: Supabase
apps.unresolved: PAT proof is strongest; project API-key/JWT and OAuth details should be checked for the chosen endpoint before implementation.

apps.name: Neo4j
apps.unresolved: Basic works for Community; do not assume bearer/SSO across all editions.

apps.name: Snowflake
apps.unresolved: Trial is suitable for SQL; production costs and account roles apply, and trial AI access is restricted.

apps.name: MongoDB Atlas
apps.unresolved: Do not confuse Atlas administration REST with database CRUD or retired Data API.

apps.name: Datadog
apps.unresolved: OAuth is documented for integration apps; full publishing requirements were not audited.

apps.name: Sentry
apps.unresolved: Free-plan existence confirmed via vendor blog; exact free feature coverage needs endpoint-specific validation.

apps.name: Notion
apps.unresolved: Free plan exists; actual signup and token generation were not performed.

apps.name: Airtable
apps.unresolved: Free monthly request cap and per-base rate limit; use PAT/OAuth, not retired API keys.

apps.name: Linear
apps.unresolved: No general access blocker; GraphQL errors can coexist with HTTP 200.

apps.name: Jira
apps.unresolved: Admin_approval denotes customer workspace policy risk, not mandatory vendor partnership.

apps.name: Asana
apps.unresolved: Core tasks/projects are easy; domain-wide service accounts and premium endpoints are separate.

apps.name: Monday.com
apps.unresolved: No core blocker; distinguish free developer test account from production plan entitlements.

apps.name: ClickUp
apps.unresolved: Limit initial toolkit to core endpoints; Enterprise-only user/guest management is excluded.

apps.name: Coda
apps.unresolved: Do not confuse auth supported by outbound Coda Packs with authentication to Coda's own API.

apps.name: Smartsheet
apps.unresolved: Paid-plan eligibility, not an absent API; obtain eligible account before implementation testing.

apps.name: Harvest
apps.unresolved: MCP discovery was not completed for Harvest; not a negative finding.

apps.name: Stripe
apps.unresolved: Ready means sandbox toolkit viable, not live-money execution tested.

apps.name: Plaid
apps.unresolved: API credential method is not the same as bank OAuth consent; MCP existence does not prove production data access.

apps.name: Binance
apps.unresolved: No financial transactions performed; Testnet and geographic restrictions remain explicit follow-up checks.

apps.name: Paygent Connect
apps.unresolved: Bounded search: Paygent Connect NMI payment API. Excluded another candidate's assignment from evidence. Unknown is not a finding that the product does not exist.

apps.name: iPayX
apps.unresolved: Compare /fx-public-api-v1 in API docs with /fx-audit-engine in developer page before implementing. No endpoint call or key acquisition performed.

apps.name: QuickBooks
apps.unresolved: MCP not independently established. Endpoint-level accounting breadth needs a follow-up reference pass.

apps.name: Xero
apps.unresolved: REST prototype is self-serve; official hosted MCP is paid-tier gated and scale incurs fees.

apps.name: Brex
apps.unresolved: Apparent production-only versus staging contradiction resolves by customer versus partner context.

apps.name: Ramp
apps.unresolved: Do not label Ramp's API itself Basic auth: Basic is used only when exchanging client credentials for an OAuth token.

apps.name: PitchBook
apps.unresolved: Standalone API license and vendor onboarding; platform subscription alone is insufficient.

limitations: No paid accounts or product credentials acquired; no authenticated functional tests.
Some access, auth, and surface breadth classifications rely on official indexed search excerpts instead of complete page reads.
MCP not_verified means not established in this bounded pass, never proof of nonexistence.
Paygent Connect identity unresolved; unrelated Paygent and NMI references are disambiguation evidence only.
Exact country/account eligibility and endpoint-plan coverage require implementation-specific checks.

correction_observations.issue: Legacy API keys are retired; PAT and OAuth supported.
Customer docs production-only versus partner staging is a contextual distinction.
